g.text: Synthetic source-contribution membership: longer trajectories and uncertain knowledge
Separate independent base and density-shift test cohorts; no pooling and no cross-cohort pairing. Balanced IN/OUT evaluation prior.
All attacks use the same 25% of candidate points; uncertain knowledge adds 2 m spatial / 200 ms temporal uncertainty.
Intervals condition on frozen models; thresholds were calibrated on base groups only. Utility uses both worlds; absent public support is unknown.
Exact-count control bypasses policy. No-output control preserves no utility. Attack failure establishes no universal privacy guarantee.
